list.snippet: Ability — Mortal Shuriken: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may discard a Basic Water Energy card from your hand to place 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
Attack — Ninja Spinner [WW] (120+): You may put a Water Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand and have this attack do 80 more damage (total 200 damage).
Weakness / Resistance / Retreat: Lightning (x2) / None / 1 Colorless.
Double Rare (#022/086): Standard holofoil version, typically trading around $1.00 to $4.00.
Ultra Rare (#100/086): Full-art or variant release, valued around $15 to $25.

Special Illustration Rare (#116/086): Illustrated by Susumu Maeya, this is a major chase card from the set.
